```{r setup}
library(here)
library(dotenv)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# Load environment variables from project root .env
dotenv::load_dot_env(here::here(".env"))
output_data_dir <- Sys.getenv("OUTPUT_DATA_DIR")

eval_data_dir <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "data")
eval_fig_dir  <- file.path(output_data_dir, "eval", "figures")

eval_path        <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "eval_test_predictions.csv")
human_infer_path <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "human_mode_inference_predictions.csv")
model_infer_path <- file.path(eval_data_dir, "model_mode_inference_predictions.csv")

if (!dir.exists(eval_fig_dir)) {
  dir.create(eval_fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
# guess_max = Inf prevents readr from guessing column types from only the first
# rows — critical for columns like segment_mean_reward where early rows are
# NaN (bandit_sep, query) before the float values appear. Without this, the
# column gets guessed as logical and every real value reads as NA.
eval_df        <- read_csv(eval_path,        show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
human_infer_df <- read_csv(human_infer_path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
model_infer_df <- read_csv(model_infer_path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)

cat("Eval (synthetic test):  ", nrow(eval_df), "rows\n")
cat("Inference human mode:   ", nrow(human_infer_df), "rows\n")
cat("Inference model mode:   ", nrow(model_infer_df), "rows\n")
```

## Build Long-Form Per-Cutoff Table

```{r build-long}
# Beta-method labels used for the new model-mode comparison figure.
beta_method_levels <- c("theta_betas", "expert_betas", "novice_betas", "recent_betas")
beta_method_labels <- c(
  theta_betas  = "Environment Priors",
  expert_betas = "Expert-Head Priors",
  novice_betas = "Novice-Head Priors",
  recent_betas = "Most-Recent-Watched Priors"
)

# Unified long-form frame with columns:
#   source, beta_method, example_key, cutoff, segment_type, segment_order,
#   game_sequence, round_index, expert_N_tot_pred, novice_N_tot_pred,
#   segment_mean_reward
#
# Filtering convention for the experience plot x-axis:
#   - watch-first segment_order only (human task has no play-first rounds)
#   - segment_type in {bandit_sep, demo, learner}; drop query (no new info)
#   - keep only the FIRST bandit_sep per example (cutoff == 1) so the
#     "no context" anchor appears once and later bandit_sep's don't clutter
#   - inference frames: carry beta_method through (no longer filtered to one
#     canonical curve), average across rollouts per session × cutoff × method
prepare_source <- function(df, source_label, key_col) {
  if (!(key_col %in% names(df))) {
    stop(sprintf("Column %s missing from %s data", key_col, source_label))
  }

  out <- df %>%
    filter(segment_order == "watch-first",
           segment_type %in% c("bandit_sep", "demo", "learner")) %>%
    filter(!(segment_type == "bandit_sep" & cutoff != 1))

  has_beta <- "beta_method" %in% names(out)
  if (!has_beta) {
    # Simulated Test source has no beta_method; sentinel keeps bind_rows happy.
    out <- out %>% mutate(beta_method = NA_character_)
  }

  grouping <- c(key_col, "beta_method", "cutoff", "segment_type",
                "segment_order", "game_sequence", "round_index")
  out <- out %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(grouping))) %>%
    summarise(
      expert_N_tot_pred   = mean(expert_N_tot_pred,   na.rm = TRUE),
      novice_N_tot_pred   = mean(novice_N_tot_pred,   na.rm = TRUE),
      segment_mean_reward = mean(segment_mean_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(example_key = !!key_col) %>%
    mutate(
      example_key = as.character(example_key),
      source = source_label
    )

  out
}

eval_session  <- prepare_source(eval_df,        "Simulated Test",  "example_id")
human_session <- prepare_source(human_infer_df, "Human Inference", "session_id")
model_session <- prepare_source(model_infer_df, "Model Inference", "session_id")

all_sessions <- bind_rows(eval_session, human_session, model_session) %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source,
                         levels = c("Simulated Test", "Human Inference", "Model Inference")))

# Pivot expert/novice into a long demonstrator_type column for the N_tot plots.
# segment_mean_reward stays as a wide column (one float per row, no demo split).
all_long <- all_sessions %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(expert_N_tot_pred, novice_N_tot_pred),
               names_to = "demonstrator_type",
               values_to = "n_total") %>%
  mutate(demonstrator_type = recode(demonstrator_type,
                                    expert_N_tot_pred = "expert",
                                    novice_N_tot_pred = "novice"))

cat("\nRows per source after filtering:\n")
print(table(all_sessions$source))
cat("\nGame sequences found:\n")
print(table(all_sessions$source, all_sessions$game_sequence))
cat("\nBeta methods present (inference sources only):\n")
print(table(all_sessions$source, all_sessions$beta_method, useNA = "ifany"))
```

## 3 x 2 N_total Comparison Figure

```{r ntot-comparison, fig.width=18, fig.height=9}
# The N_total plot pins inference sources to the canonical theta_betas curve.
# (The model-mode 4-method comparison is rendered in a separate figure below.)
ntot_long <- all_long %>%
  filter(source == "Simulated Test" | beta_method == "theta_betas")

# Aggregate to mean +/- SE across sessions per (source, game_sequence, cutoff, demo_type).
summary_df <- ntot_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_total)) %>%
  group_by(source, game_sequence, cutoff, segment_type, demonstrator_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n_total = mean(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_n_total   = sd(n_total,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_obs        = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Only keep the two watch-first game sequences present in the human data.
sequence_levels <- c("expert-play-novice-play-choice",
                     "novice-play-expert-play-choice")
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  filter(game_sequence %in% sequence_levels) %>%
  mutate(game_sequence = factor(game_sequence, levels = sequence_levels,
                                labels = c("Expert First", "Novice First")))

all_long_plot <- ntot_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_total),
         game_sequence %in% sequence_levels) %>%
  mutate(game_sequence = factor(game_sequence, levels = sequence_levels,
                                labels = c("Expert First", "Novice First")))

colors <- c(expert = "#1f77b4", novice = "#d62728")

# Ground-truth N_total (expert and novice) from the eval CSV. These are the
# actual per-example labels generated by the simulator, averaged across the
# eval set. Assuming the human experiment drew demonstrators from the same
# distribution as training, these serve as the canonical ground truth line
# for every panel. Computed from the data rather than hardcoded so the plot
# stays correct if the training distribution changes.
true_n_total <- eval_df %>%
  summarise(
    expert = mean(expert_N_tot_true, na.rm = TRUE),
    novice = mean(novice_N_tot_true, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat(sprintf("Ground-truth N_total (from eval): expert=%.2f, novice=%.2f\n",
            true_n_total$expert, true_n_total$novice))

y_limits <- c(
  min(0, min(all_long_plot$n_total, na.rm = TRUE), true_n_total$novice),
  max(max(all_long_plot$n_total, na.rm = TRUE), true_n_total$expert) * 1.05
)

# x-axis: cutoffs along the watch-first schedule, in ascending order.
# With 3 rounds x (bandit_sep + demo + learner + demo + learner + query),
# the plotted cutoffs are {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15, 16, 17}.
# Label each with a human-readable segment name conditional on game_sequence.
segment_label_for <- function(cutoff, sequence_label) {
  first_watch  <- if (sequence_label == "Expert First") "Expert" else "Novice"
  second_watch <- if (sequence_label == "Expert First") "Novice" else "Expert"
  # Within a round: bandit_sep (only round 1), D1, L1, D2, L2
  tribble(
    ~cutoff, ~label,
    1L,  "None",
    2L,  paste(first_watch, "(R1)"),
    3L,  "Play (R1)",
    4L,  paste(second_watch, "(R1)"),
    5L,  "Play (R1)",
    8L,  paste(first_watch, "(R2)"),
    9L,  "Play (R2)",
    10L, paste(second_watch, "(R2)"),
    11L, "Play (R2)",
    14L, paste(first_watch, "(R3)"),
    15L, "Play (R3)",
    16L, paste(second_watch, "(R3)"),
    17L, "Play (R3)"
  )
}

build_panel <- function(panel_summary, title, sequence_label) {
  labels_df <- segment_label_for(NULL, sequence_label)
  x_breaks  <- labels_df$cutoff

  ggplot(panel_summary, aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_n_total, color = demonstrator_type)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(6.5, 12.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    # Ground-truth reference lines (same in every panel, computed from eval CSV).
    geom_hline(yintercept = true_n_total$expert, linetype = "dashed",
               color = colors[["expert"]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = true_n_total$novice, linetype = "dashed",
               color = colors[["novice"]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_n_total - se_n_total,
                      ymax = mean_n_total + se_n_total),
                  width = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors,
                       labels = c(expert = "Expert", novice = "Novice")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = labels_df$label) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 17.5), ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Cutoff (most recent segment visible)",
      y = expression(N[total]),
      color = "Demonstrator"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Pretty per-source panel title prefixes. The model column gets a parenthetical
# tag so it's explicit which Thompson prior is being shown.
ntot_source_titles <- c(
  "Simulated Test"  = "Simulated Test",
  "Human Inference" = "Human Inference",
  "Model Inference" = "Model Inference (Environment Priors)"
)

panels <- list()
for (seq_label in c("Expert First", "Novice First")) {
  for (source_label in levels(summary_df$source)) {
    panel_summary <- summary_df %>%
      filter(source == source_label, game_sequence == seq_label)
    panel_title <- paste0(ntot_source_titles[[source_label]], ": ", seq_label)
    panels[[paste(seq_label, source_label, sep = " | ")]] <-
      build_panel(panel_summary, panel_title, seq_label)
  }
}

# Arrange: 2 rows (game_sequence) x 3 cols (source)
grid_plot <- (panels[[1]] | panels[[2]] | panels[[3]]) /
             (panels[[4]] | panels[[5]] | panels[[6]]) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Demonstrator N_total Experience Predictions",
    subtitle = "Per-cutoff posterior N_total by source (cols) and demonstrator order (rows)",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

legend_plot <- build_panel(
    summary_df %>% filter(source == "Simulated Test", game_sequence == "Expert First"),
    "Simulated Test: Expert First",
    "Expert First"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 25)))
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

final_plot <- grid_plot / wrap_elements(legend_grob) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.08))

print(final_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_comparison.png"),
  plot = final_plot, width = 18, height = 9, dpi = 150, bg = "white"
)
cat("\nFigure saved to:", file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_comparison.png"), "\n")
```

## Model-Mode N_total by Thompson Prior Method

```{r ntot-model-beta-methods-comparison, fig.width=22, fig.height=9}
# Model-mode posteriors for all four Thompson-sampling prior conditions.
# Reuses the same x-axis convention, ground-truth dashed lines, and
# expert/novice colors as ntot_comparison.png.
model_beta_long <- all_long %>%
  filter(source == "Model Inference",
         !is.na(beta_method),
         beta_method %in% beta_method_levels,
         !is.na(n_total),
         game_sequence %in% sequence_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    game_sequence = factor(game_sequence, levels = sequence_levels,
                           labels = c("Expert First", "Novice First")),
    beta_method = factor(beta_method, levels = beta_method_levels)
  )

model_beta_summary <- model_beta_long %>%
  group_by(beta_method, game_sequence, cutoff, segment_type, demonstrator_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_n_total = mean(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_n_total   = sd(n_total,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_obs        = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_panels <- list()
for (seq_label in c("Expert First", "Novice First")) {
  for (bm in beta_method_levels) {
    panel_summary <- model_beta_summary %>%
      filter(beta_method == bm, game_sequence == seq_label)
    panel_title <- paste0(beta_method_labels[[bm]], ": ", seq_label)
    model_panels[[paste(seq_label, bm, sep = " | ")]] <-
      build_panel(panel_summary, panel_title, seq_label)
  }
}

model_grid <- (model_panels[[1]] | model_panels[[2]] | model_panels[[3]] | model_panels[[4]]) /
              (model_panels[[5]] | model_panels[[6]] | model_panels[[7]] | model_panels[[8]]) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Model Inference: N_total by Thompson Prior Method",
    subtitle = "Per-cutoff posterior N_total across the four Thompson-sampling prior conditions",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

model_legend_plot <- build_panel(
    model_beta_summary %>%
      filter(beta_method == "theta_betas", game_sequence == "Expert First"),
    "legend",
    "Expert First"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 25)))
model_legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(model_legend_plot)

model_final_plot <- model_grid / wrap_elements(model_legend_grob) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.08))

print(model_final_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_model_beta_methods_comparison.png"),
  plot = model_final_plot, width = 22, height = 9, dpi = 150, bg = "white"
)
cat("\nFigure saved to:", file.path(eval_fig_dir, "ntot_model_beta_methods_comparison.png"), "\n")
```

## Per-Game Mean Reward Comparison (one figure per Thompson prior)

```{r mean-reward-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# Per-game mean reward (over the 6 trials of the game ending at this cutoff).
# One 1x2 figure (Expert First | Novice First). Demo points are shared across
# all inference conditions (verified: demo segment_mean_reward is identical
# across human/model modes and across beta_methods), so they're drawn once per
# panel from a single canonical source. Play curves overlay five conditions:
# Human play + four Thompson-prior methods.

# Segment-role derivation. Within a watch-first round the schedule is:
#   pos 2 = D1, 3 = L1, 4 = D2, 5 = L2
# D1 identity depends on game_sequence; D2 is the opposite.
reward_long_all <- all_sessions %>%
  filter(segment_order == "watch-first",
         segment_type %in% c("demo", "learner"),
         !is.na(segment_mean_reward),
         game_sequence %in% sequence_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    game_sequence = factor(game_sequence, levels = sequence_levels,
                           labels = c("Expert First", "Novice First")),
    pos_in_round  = ((cutoff - 1) %% 6) + 1,
    segment_role  = case_when(
      segment_type == "learner" ~ "play",
      segment_type == "demo" & pos_in_round == 2 & game_sequence == "Expert First" ~ "expert_demo",
      segment_type == "demo" & pos_in_round == 2 & game_sequence == "Novice First" ~ "novice_demo",
      segment_type == "demo" & pos_in_round == 4 & game_sequence == "Expert First" ~ "novice_demo",
      segment_type == "demo" & pos_in_round == 4 & game_sequence == "Novice First" ~ "expert_demo",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

reward_summary_all <- reward_long_all %>%
  group_by(source, beta_method, game_sequence, cutoff, segment_type, segment_role) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_reward = mean(segment_mean_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_reward   = sd(segment_mean_reward,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n_obs       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Demo points: provably identical across all (source, beta_method) combos, so
# pick one canonical slice for each panel. (See 'Context' in the plan file.)
demo_summary <- reward_summary_all %>%
  filter(source == "Human Inference",
         beta_method == "theta_betas",
         segment_role %in% c("expert_demo", "novice_demo"))

# Five play curves: Human play + the four Thompson-prior methods in model mode.
play_summary <- reward_summary_all %>%
  filter(segment_role == "play",
         (source == "Human Inference" & beta_method == "theta_betas") |
         (source == "Model Inference")) %>%
  mutate(series = case_when(
    source == "Human Inference"                                 ~ "Human play",
    source == "Model Inference" & beta_method == "theta_betas"  ~ "Model: Environment priors",
    source == "Model Inference" & beta_method == "expert_betas" ~ "Model: Expert-head priors",
    source == "Model Inference" & beta_method == "novice_betas" ~ "Model: Novice-head priors",
    source == "Model Inference" & beta_method == "recent_betas" ~ "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"
  )) %>%
  mutate(series = factor(series, levels = c(
    "Human play",
    "Model: Environment priors",
    "Model: Expert-head priors",
    "Model: Novice-head priors",
    "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"
  )))

reward_color_values <- c(
  expert_demo                          = "#1f77b4",
  novice_demo                          = "#d62728",
  "Human play"                         = "#111111",
  "Model: Environment priors"          = "#ff7f0e",
  "Model: Expert-head priors"          = "#2ca02c",
  "Model: Novice-head priors"          = "#9467bd",
  "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"  = "#8c564b"
)
reward_color_breaks <- c(
  "expert_demo", "novice_demo",
  "Human play",
  "Model: Environment priors",
  "Model: Expert-head priors",
  "Model: Novice-head priors",
  "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"
)
reward_color_labels <- c(
  "Expert (watch)", "Novice (watch)",
  "Human play",
  "Model: Environment priors",
  "Model: Expert-head priors",
  "Model: Novice-head priors",
  "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"
)

build_reward_panel <- function(demo_rows, play_rows, title, sequence_label) {
  labels_df <- segment_label_for(NULL, sequence_label) %>% filter(cutoff != 1)
  x_breaks  <- labels_df$cutoff
  play_model_rows <- play_rows %>% filter(series != "Human play")
  play_human_rows <- play_rows %>% filter(series == "Human play")

  ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(6.5, 12.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
    # Model play curves first (drawn underneath)
    geom_line(data = play_model_rows,
              aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = series, group = series),
              linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_errorbar(data = play_model_rows,
                  aes(x = cutoff,
                      ymin = mean_reward - se_reward,
                      ymax = mean_reward + se_reward,
                      color = series),
                  width = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = play_model_rows,
               aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = series),
               size = 2.5) +
    # Demo points (on top of model curves)
    geom_errorbar(data = demo_rows,
                  aes(x = cutoff,
                      ymin = mean_reward - se_reward,
                      ymax = mean_reward + se_reward,
                      color = segment_role),
                  width = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = demo_rows,
               aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = segment_role),
               size = 3) +
    # Human play drawn last so it sits on top, with a thicker stroke
    geom_line(data = play_human_rows,
              aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = series, group = series),
              linewidth = 1.4) +
    geom_errorbar(data = play_human_rows,
                  aes(x = cutoff,
                      ymin = mean_reward - se_reward,
                      ymax = mean_reward + se_reward,
                      color = series),
                  width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = play_human_rows,
               aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = series),
               size = 3.2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = reward_color_values,
      breaks = reward_color_breaks,
      labels = reward_color_labels
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = labels_df$label) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1.5, 17.5), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "Game (segment ending at this cutoff)",
         y = "Mean reward (per game, 6 trials)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.title  = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          legend.position = "none")
}

panels <- list()
for (seq_label in c("Expert First", "Novice First")) {
  panels[[seq_label]] <- build_reward_panel(
    demo_rows = demo_summary %>% filter(game_sequence == seq_label),
    play_rows = play_summary %>% filter(game_sequence == seq_label),
    title     = seq_label,
    sequence_label = seq_label
  )
}

grid_plot <- (panels[["Expert First"]] | panels[["Novice First"]]) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Per-Game Mean Reward",
    subtitle = "Mean reward over the 6 trials of each game. Demo points shared; play curves overlay the 5 conditions.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

# Two stacked legends: demo (expert/novice) on top, play series below. Built
# from single-group mini-plots so each has its own color scale.
demo_legend_plot <- ggplot(demo_summary,
                           aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = segment_role)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(expert_demo = "#1f77b4", novice_demo = "#d62728"),
    breaks = c("expert_demo", "novice_demo"),
    labels = c("Expert (watch)", "Novice (watch)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(l = 4, r = 18)),
        legend.title      = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width  = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x  = grid::unit(0.6, "cm")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
demo_legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(demo_legend_plot)

play_series_levels <- c(
  "Human play",
  "Model: Environment priors",
  "Model: Expert-head priors",
  "Model: Novice-head priors",
  "Model: Most-recent-watched priors"
)
play_legend_plot <- ggplot(play_summary,
                           aes(x = cutoff, y = mean_reward, color = series)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = series), linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = reward_color_values[play_series_levels],
    breaks = play_series_levels,
    labels = play_series_levels
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(l = 4, r = 18)),
        legend.title      = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width  = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x  = grid::unit(0.6, "cm")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
play_legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(play_legend_plot)

final_plot <- grid_plot /
  wrap_elements(demo_legend_grob) /
  wrap_elements(play_legend_grob) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.08, 0.08))

out_path <- file.path(eval_fig_dir, "mean_reward_comparison.png")
ggsave(filename = out_path, plot = final_plot,
       width = 14, height = 6.5, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
cat("\nFigure saved to:", out_path, "\n")
print(final_plot)
```
